Rally ID: 60. Roman coin: A heavily worn struck / hammered copper alloy radiate, probably of Claudius II (268 - 270 AD) of reverse type of soldier standing left with globe and spear. Obverse: Bust facing right. Obverse inscription: [ ] MP CCLAVDIVS [ ]. Reverse: Standing figure. Reverse inscription: [ ] O S [ ]. Diameter: 19.65mm. Thickness: 2.15mm. Weight: 2.2 grams.
